tasks.label: statusline: push sample input
tasks.detail: Pipes a sample Claude Code statusline JSON into the helper, as Claude Code would; start a sandboxed tray first
args: $env:LOCALAPPDATA = '${workspaceFolder}/target/dev-appdata'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:LOCALAPPDATA | Out-Null; $now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds(); $json = @{ rate_limits = @{ five_hour = @{ used_percentage = ${input:fiveHourPercent}; resets_at = $now + 7200 }; seven_day = @{ used_percentage = ${input:sevenDayPercent}; resets_at = $now + 259200 } } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress; $json | & '${workspaceFolder}/target/debug/uqt-statusline.exe'
